text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data as it travels between the user and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through strong passwords or two-factor methods. Developers must also validate all input to stop malicious code from entering the system. Common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, are often caused by weak input handling. By following basic security practices, developers can reduce risks and build safer, more trustworthy websites for everyone.
